battle.name: 比利時革命
battle.theater: 布魯塞爾城區與斯海爾特河口
battle.brief: 一八三〇年八月廿五日，布魯塞爾民眾與南省軍隊在街壘上逼退荷軍，九月戰鬥之後南部宣布獨立，荷蘭國王仍留安特衛普城塞不肯放手。法軍兩度越境，終於一八三二年以攻城重砲拿下城塞，比利時於一八三九年獲列強承認。野砲在革命中先後扮演街壘前的營屬砲與城塞下的攻城重砲兩種角色。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 交戰的兩方是荷蘭聯合王國與從南部省份分離出來的比利時革命者。荷方以威廉一世為國王，軍隊與政權集中在北部，一八三〇年八月他先後派王儲威廉與小腓特烈王子率兵南下平叛，主要據點是安特衛普的城塞與要塞群。革命一方先由布魯塞爾臨時政府領導，核心人物是沙克萊與羅吉耶，後由國民大會改組國家；軍隊方面，一八三〇年九月之後由志願者與民兵組成的比利時軍在梅茲河與佛蘭德倫一線集結，一八三一年八月國王利奧波德一世即位後軍隊正式編制化。法國是決定性的外援：一八三一年八月九日熱拉爾元帥率法軍越境，兵力在七萬人上下；一八三二年十一月十五日至十二月二十三日，法軍北方軍團在工程總監阿克索主持下圍攻安特衛普城塞，是荷軍在本土的最後堡壘。英國自一八三〇年倫敦會議起以承認獨立與維持歐洲均勢為由支持革命者的合法地位，但直接出兵有限。奧地利、普魯士與俄羅斯受德意志與波蘭的動亂牽制，只在外交上反對分離。
countriesEn: The two sides were the United Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Belgian revolutionaries who had seceded from its southern provinces. On the Dutch side William I was king, with the army and the government concentrated in the north; in August 1830 he sent the crown prince William and his younger brother Prince Frederick south to put down the revolt, and his main positions were the citadel and the fortified works at Antwerp. On the revolutionary side the movement was at first led by the provisional government in Brussels, whose leading figures were de Chokier and Rogier, and was later turned into a state by the National Congress; militarily, the volunteer and militia forces that had formed after September 1830 were concentrated along the Meuse and in Flanders, and after Leopold I became king in August 1831 the army was regularised. France was the decisive external help: on 9 August 1831 Marshal Gérard crossed the frontier with a force of about seventy thousand men, and from 15 November to 23 December 1832 the Armée du Nord, under the direction of the engineer-in-chief Baron Haxo, besieged the citadel of Antwerp, the last fortress the Dutch held in the homeland. Britain, from the London Conference of 1830 onwards, supported the legal position of the revolutionaries by recognising independence and by preserving the European balance, but its direct military involvement was limited. Austria, Prussia and Russia were absorbed by the movements in Germany and Poland and opposed separation only diplomatically.
people: 威廉一世是荷方核心：他拒絕承認比利時獨立，理由是南部省份的人口與稅收佔王國過半，分裂會掏空國庫；一八三〇年八月他派王儲威廉與小腓特烈王子率兵進城，卻在布魯塞爾街巷的衝突中下令撤退，兩位王子的聲譽因此受損，小腓特烈更在九月戰鬥中以騎兵衝鋒而未能突破街壘。革命陣營裡，臨時政府的沙克萊與羅吉耶掌握行政，後來的利奧波德一世是列強選出的折衷人選：他是薩克森－科堡－哥達出身的親王，又與英國王室有姻親，被英國接受而讓法國退讓，於一八三一年七月二十一日加冕。熱拉爾元帥是法軍方面的決策者，他兩度開進比利時；工程總監阿克索男爵是安特衛普攻城戰的技術主導，他主張放棄坑道與平行壕溝的傳統攻城法，改以大口徑臼炮把炸彈從上方拋入堡壘，圍城因此在二十四天內結束。荷方城塞守將查西中將是荷軍抵抗的象徵，他以熱彈射擊安特衛普城區，是荷蘭在南方留下的最後武力。比利時方面，各城的國民守衛隊長與志願兵指揮官在八九月間守住街道與城門，臨時政府的軍隊後來由利奧波德整編為常備軍。
peopleEn: William I was the central figure on the Dutch side. He refused to recognise Belgian independence on the ground that the southern provinces held more than half the population and the revenues of the kingdom and that their separation would empty the treasury; in August 1830 he sent the crown prince and Prince Frederick into the city, but withdrew them after the street fighting in Brussels, and the reputation of both princes suffered, the younger Frederik failing to break through the barricades with his cavalry during the September Days. On the revolutionary side de Chokier and Rogier ran the provisional government, and Leopold I was the compromise candidate chosen by the powers: a prince of the house of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha and a relative by marriage of the British royal family, he was acceptable to Britain and to France, which gave way, and he was crowned on 21 July 1831. Marshal Gérard was the decision maker on the French side, entering Belgium twice; Baron Haxo, the engineer-in-chief, was the technical master of the siege of Antwerp, where he abandoned the traditional Vauban method of saps and parallels in favour of large mortars firing shells from above, and the fortress fell within twenty-four days. On the Dutch side Chassé, the commander of the citadel, was the emblem of Dutch resistance, using heated shot against the city of Antwerp and representing the last Dutch force in the south. On the Belgian side the commanders of the civic guards and of the volunteers held the streets and the gates in August and September, and the troops of the provisional government were later regularised by Leopold into a standing army.
kits: 野砲在這場革命裡經歷了兩種完全不同的角色。第一種是街壘與城門前的營屬砲：荷軍進入布魯塞爾時攜帶團屬與營屬的火砲，在八月的衝突與九月十九日至二十三日的九月戰鬥中，用砲火對付以鋪路石、翻覆的公共馬車與屋頂材料築成的街壘；革命者則大量使用獵槍、手槍，以及從軍械店和國民衛軍倉庫繳獲的舊式火槍，砲是他們最缺的東西，無力成建制地集中火。第二種是攻城重砲：安特衛普城塞是十七世紀沃邦體系的星形要塞，一八三二年法軍北方軍團在阿克索主持下改用大口徑臼炮，把炸彈從上方拋入堡壘之內，取代此前以坑道與平行壕溝進行的傳統攻城法；法軍投入兵力在五萬至六萬之間，荷軍城塞守備約四千五百人，圍城自十一月十五日打到十二月二十三日。城塞守軍以荷蘭的團屬火砲配合熱彈射擊市區，比利時國防軍則沿斯海爾特河北岸的堤壩布防，防止荷軍以砲火拆毀堤壆。荷蘭的野戰砲多為一八〇〇年前後的團屬砲與六磅營屬砲，裝備與火力都落在歐洲平均線以下；法軍的攻城重砲則是當時歐洲最完整的一批攻城器材。安特衛普城塞投降後，其中的火砲與守備人員一併交予比利時，一八三五年利奧波德另以數門不同口徑的砲贈予法國。
kitsEn: The field gun played two entirely different roles in this revolution. The first was the brigade gun in front of barricades and city gates: the Dutch troops entering Brussels brought brigade and battery pieces with them, and in the fighting of August and in the September Days of 19 to 23 September they used their guns against barricades built of paving stones, overturned omnibuses and roofing material. The revolutionaries used a great many hunting guns, pistols and old muskets taken from armourers' shops and from the stores of the civic guard, and guns were precisely what they lacked, being unable to concentrate fire in formed batteries. The second was the heavy siege gun: the citadel of Antwerp was a seventeenth-century Vauban-style star fort, and in 1832 the Armée du Nord under Haxo substituted large mortars for the traditional sap and parallel, dropping shells into the works from above. The French committed between fifty and sixty thousand men against a garrison of about four thousand five hundred, and the siege ran from 15 November to 23 December. The garrison answered with Dutch brigade guns firing heated shot into the city, while the Belgian national army manned the dykes on the north bank of the Scheldt so that the Dutch could not destroy them with their fire. The Dutch field pieces were mostly brigade guns and six-pounder battery pieces of about 1800, below the European average in equipment and in firepower; the French siege train was among the most complete in Europe at the time. After the citadel surrendered its guns and its personnel passed to Belgium, and in 1835 Leopold presented a number of guns of different calibres to France in return.
tactics: 起義方以城市街道為戰場：街壘用翻覆的馬車、公共馬車、鋪路石與屋頂材料築成，把寬闊大道逐段切斷，使荷軍的直射砲火失去縱深優勢；革命者的戰術是消耗與延遲，用零散射擊騷擾守軍、趁夜增援，迫使對方逐點清剿。九月的布魯塞爾之戰裡，荷軍騎兵在幾個主要路口被街壘與人牆擋住，步兵因懼怕在狹窄街巷中面對大量散兵而遲遲不前，最終整隊退回城塞。革命方在奪取城塞後轉向鄉村，以縱隊巡邏、封鎖道路、奪取稅站與維持城鄉間的傳信系統對抗游擊式鎮壓。荷蘭在被迫承認獨立後轉守安特衛普城塞，用高角度火砲控制市區，並以熱彈破壞城內樓房，企圖以火力維持對安特衛普的實際控制；比利時國防軍則在斯海爾特河的堤壩線上組織防禦，並在城塞投降後接管該處。一八三一年的十日戰役中荷軍一度攻入，並在哈瑟爾特擊敗梅茲河軍，卻在法軍越境後被追回，形成比利時式的速戰速決、外國干預、停戰循環；一八三二年法軍則改採圍城不攻，專以攻城重砲拆解城塞。
tacticsEn: The insurgents fought the city as their battlefield. Barricades of overturned carts, omnibuses, paving stones and roofing material cut the wide avenues into sections and deprived the Dutch guns of the depth they needed; the revolutionary method was one of exhaustion and delay, harassing the defenders with scattered fire, reinforcing at night and forcing them to clear point by point. In the September fighting in Brussels the Dutch cavalry was checked at several main crossings by barricades and human walls, and the infantry hesitated to advance in narrow streets against a multitude of skirmishers, so that the troops withdrew in good order to the citadel. Once the city had been taken the revolutionaries turned to the countryside, patrolling in columns, closing roads, seizing tax posts and keeping up the postal system between town and village against a war of detachments and suppression. Compelled to accept independence, the Dutch fell back on the citadel of Antwerp, controlling the city with high-angle guns and using heated shot against the houses inside it in the attempt to keep Antwerp in practice in their own hands; the Belgian national army organised its defence along the dykes of the Scheldt and took over the citadel after its surrender. In the Ten Days' Campaign of 1831 the Dutch penetrated the country, took Antwerp on 4 August and defeated the Army of the Meuse at Hasselt, but were driven back once the French crossed the frontier, producing the Belgian version of the cycle of quick war, foreign intervention and armistice; in 1832 the French changed method and took the citadel by siege alone, breaking it with the heavy guns.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。起義自一八三〇年八月廿五日布魯塞爾爆發衝突起，九月十九日至二十三日進行決定性的九月戰鬥，九月廿七日臨時政府宣告獨立，十月四日宣布完全獨立，十一月十八日由國民大會確認。一八三一年八月二日荷軍再度入侵，八月四日佔領安特衛普，並在哈瑟爾特擊敗梅茲河軍；八月九日法軍越境，兵力約七萬；八月十二日魯汶之戰後荷軍同意停戰。一八三二年十一月十五日法軍北方軍團開始圍攻安特衛普城塞，十二月二十三日城塞守軍投降，圍城歷時二十四天；法軍投入五萬至六千人，荷軍守備約四千五百人，法軍損失約六百零八人陣亡、一千八百人受傷，荷軍約九十人陣亡、三百四十九人受傷。革命軍與荷軍的總兵力，史料分別記作六萬人與五萬人上下。安特衛普城塞投降後，國王利奧波德以數門不同口徑的火砲贈予法國，熱拉爾獲贈榮譽劍；一八三九年《倫敦條約》確認比利時獨立，威廉一世直到一八三九年才簽字。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The rising began with the clash in Brussels on 25 August 1830; the decisive September Days were fought from 19 to 23 September; the provisional government proclaimed independence on 27 September; independence was declared outright on 4 October and confirmed by the National Congress on 18 November. The Dutch invaded again on 2 August 1831, occupied Antwerp on the fourth, and defeated the Army of the Meuse at Hasselt; the French crossed the frontier on 9 August with about seventy thousand men, and after the battle of Leuven on 12 August the Dutch agreed to an armistice. On 15 November 1832 the Armée du Nord began the siege of the citadel of Antwerp, which surrendered on 23 December after twenty-four days: the French committed between fifty and sixty thousand men against a garrison of about four thousand five hundred, losing about six hundred and eight men killed and one thousand eight hundred wounded, while the Dutch lost about ninety killed and three hundred and forty-nine wounded. The total strengths of the revolutionary and Dutch armies are recorded at about sixty thousand and about fifty thousand respectively. After the surrender Leopold gave France a number of guns of different calibres and Gérard received a sword of honour; the Treaty of London confirmed Belgian independence in 1839, and William I did not sign until that year.
cause: 起因是維也納會議把南北荷蘭合併之後的結構性矛盾。一八一五年荷蘭王國吞併原來的南尼德蘭，聯省議會設在北部，官方語言只有荷蘭語，一八一九年之後連公務員考試也要求懂荷蘭語，軍政高位幾乎清一色由北方人出任；兩省人口雖相近，比利時卻要分擔荷蘭在拿破崙戰爭中舉借的債務，而南方工業與北方商業、漁業之間又有政策衝突：荷蘭偏好自由貿易，比利時希望保護本土工業。宗教上的分野同樣剛硬，北方以新教為主，南方以天主教為主，比利時擔心聯合王國無法保障天主教的教會地位與教育體系。一八三〇年七月法國七月革命成功，同年夏天比利時南部因物價上漲與失業而爆發騷動，布魯塞爾的街壘一經築成，軍隊倒戈，革命便由騷動變成分離運動。列強的態度決定了結局：奧地利、普魯士與俄國想維持一八一五年的歐洲版圖，卻各自陷於德意志與波蘭的動亂；法國樂於看荷蘭王國分裂，卻又擔心比利時過分親法而危及英吉利海峽的防務；英國則希望以承認獨立換取比利時不與法國過分結盟，於是有了利奧波德這個人選。
causeEn: The cause lay in the structural contradictions that followed the merging of the northern and southern Netherlands at the Congress of Vienna. In 1815 the Kingdom of the Netherlands absorbed the former Southern Netherlands, the States General sat in the north, the only official language was Dutch, and after 1819 even the civil service examinations required Dutch, the senior military and administrative posts being almost entirely in northern hands. The two provinces had a similar population, but Belgium had to share the debts incurred by the Netherlands during the Napoleonic wars, and there was a policy conflict between the industry of the south and the commerce and fisheries of the north: the Dutch favoured free trade, Belgium wanted protection for its own manufactures. The religious divide was just as hard, the north being predominantly Protestant and the south Catholic, and Belgium feared that the united kingdom would not guarantee the position of the Catholic Church and of its schools. The July Revolution in France succeeded in July 1830, and in the same summer unrest broke out in the southern provinces over rising prices and unemployment; once the barricades went up in Brussels and the troops changed sides, a riot became a movement for separation. The attitude of the powers settled the outcome. Austria, Prussia and Russia wanted to preserve the European map of 1815, but each was absorbed by the movements in Germany and Poland. France was glad to see the Dutch kingdom split, yet worried that a Belgium too close to France would endanger British security in the Channel. Britain preferred to buy off the danger by recognising independence in exchange for a Belgium that would not throw itself into France's arms, and hence the choice of Leopold.
impact: 獨立帶來的第一個後果是維也納體制的裂痕。比利時分離之後，歐洲出現第二個由革命建立的國家，一八三一年二月頒布的憲法是當時歐洲最自由的一部，確立了議會制君主立憲、言論與結社自由，比利時此後的政治結構至今仍以它為基礎。荷蘭則退守北方的框框，一八三九年放棄對比利時的任何主張，卻在分割中失去了南方的商業港口與佛蘭德爾的工業區，此後幾十年只能靠北海航運維持國力；比利時也付出代價：南部沿海的安特衛普被分割，比利時直到十九世紀末仍是一個內陸的工業國家。對法國，比利時的成立既是七月革命的延伸，也讓法國多了一個陸地上的外交對手；對英國而言，承認比利時換來了萊茵河口與安特衛普的商業與戰略通道，但也意味著歐洲大陸出現了一個拒絕與英國合併的鄰國。更深一層的影響是示範效應：法國的七月革命、比利時的獨立與波蘭的十一月起義在同一年並列，維也納會議之後被壓制的民族與自由主義運動在歐洲各地陸續爆發，一八三〇年被後世視為整個世紀的轉折點。
impactEn: The first consequence of independence was a crack in the Vienna settlement. After the separation there was a second state in Europe created by revolution; the constitution promulgated in February 1831 was the most liberal in Europe at the time, establishing a parliamentary constitutional monarchy with freedom of speech and of association, and the political structure of Belgium still rests on it today. The Netherlands fell back on the northern remnant, renounced any claim on Belgium in 1839, and in the partition lost the commercial ports of the south and the industrial districts of Flanders, being able for decades thereafter to sustain itself only on North Sea shipping. Belgium paid too: the southern coastal port of Antwerp went to the north, and Belgium remained an inland industrial country until the late nineteenth century. For France the new state was both an extension of the July Revolution and a land opponent added to its diplomatic calculations. For Britain, recognising Belgium opened the Rhine mouths and Antwerp to British commerce and strategy, but it also meant a neighbour on the Continent that refused to be merged with Britain. Deeper still was the demonstration effect: the July Revolution in France, Belgian independence and the Polish November Uprising all belong to the same year, and the national and liberal movements that the Congress of Vienna had suppressed broke out in one European country after another, so that 1830 came to be seen as the turning point of the century.
result: 革命的直接結果是荷蘭聯合王國的解體：南部七個省份組成比利時王國，臨時政府在一八三〇年九月廿七日宣告獨立，國民大會十一月十八日確認，一八三一年二月頒布憲法，七月二十一日利奧波德一世宣誓即位，首都選在布魯塞爾。荷蘭方面以十日戰役的失敗承認軍事解決不可行，但仍以安特衛普城塞為最後據點，直到一八三二年十二月法軍以二十四天圍攻攻下城塞，才交出最後的堡壘。技術上的結果之一是：城塞的守備方式在攻城重砲面前失效，荷軍隨後重建國防，法軍則以北方軍團在邊境常駐，比利時軍隊在隨後十年裡成為歐洲一支以快速反應與要塞技術見長的軍隊。外交上，結果是《一八三九年倫敦條約》由奧地利、俄國、法國、英國與普魯士五國確認比利時獨立，並保障其永久中立，威廉一世在拖延多年後簽字。戰爭最終的帳面並不平衡：革命方贏得了國家，卻同時失去了安特衛普這座最重要的港口；荷蘭失去了南方，卻保住了國家的統一與北海的航線。
resultEn: The immediate result of the revolution was the dissolution of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands: the seven southern provinces formed the Kingdom of Belgium, the provisional government proclaimed independence on 27 September 1830, the National Congress confirmed it on 18 November, a constitution was promulgated in February 1831, and on 21 July Leopold I was sworn in, with Brussels as the capital. On the Dutch side the failure of the Ten Days' Campaign showed that a military solution was impossible, but the citadel of Antwerp was still held as the last position, and it was not given up until the French took it in December 1832 after a siege of twenty-four days. One of the technical results is that the defence of the citadel had failed against heavy guns; the Dutch rebuilt their national defences, the French kept the Armée du Nord permanently on the frontier, and the Belgian army became within a decade a European force noted for rapid reaction and for its work on fortifications. Diplomatically the result was the Treaty of London of 1839, by which Austria, Russia, France, Britain and Prussia recognised Belgian independence and guaranteed its permanent neutrality, William I signing only after many years of delay. The final balance of the war is not even: the revolutionaries won a state and at the same time lost the single most important port, Antwerp, while the Dutch lost the south but kept the unity of the kingdom and the North Sea routes.
